targets.query:
from(bucket: "k6testing")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_requests_success")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k6testing")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_requests_failed")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k6testing")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_requests")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k6testing")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_request_duration")
    |> group(columns: ["instrumentation", "status"], mode: "by")
    |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: (column, tables=<-) => 
        tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column), createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k6testing")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_total")
    |> group(columns: ["instrumentation", "_measurement"], mode: "by")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: (column, tables=<-) => 
        tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column), createEmpty: false)
    |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "cpu_total"}))
